1935, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 52 Cont. Oct. 14 Herbert Nichols - 39 - for success in business. Mary Gore - Success in Busin. Blank Page
Page 53 Page 54
Oct. 16 Thanksgiving - Wm. Crowley, the "hopeless" diabetic case - thought to be dead October 2nd two weeks To-day is improving - up and a- round in a wheel chair & happy.
Cha's A. Campbell .. Business prop.
Mrs. Eva Randebrush - 38 - "Christian Church" - terrible headaches ... all life.
16 Helen Johnson - 31 - lymphatic lucemia - badly swolen - said to be blood condition 29 comes back leg - in perfect shape. Deo. Gr .! Position loss ... fears
Edna Gabrash - 2 yrs. paralysed ... Rita Schultz - 14 - accident - eye threateded.
Blank page.
Page 55 Page 56 Oct. 19 Sam Serra - 42 - believed to cursed - was away from confession for many yrs. - recently went to confession and Com. & for a time things went better.
Casimur Stachowski - 42 - blood-cancer only a miracle can save her ... Mrs. Loretta Vermeessch - 30 - T.B. still at home
Mrs. Norma Deratany - middle aged - heart and sight - something like a stroke. Husband "Orthodox - five yrs. away from confession.
Sister M. Winnifred - Pembroke Ont. - severe headaches, just able to keep in school with .... sacrifice.
